objective: Add deterministic read-only, source-bound substantive review and readiness assessment using declared independent cases, actual candidate diff, negative/fault/temporal proof selectors and fail-closed control-change handling without granting acceptance or merge authority.
nonGoals: No automatic reviewer assignment or external review service
No automatic acceptance, merge, release, deployment or GitHub Actions invocation
No network calls, arbitrary project command execution or mutation during review
No assertion that candidate-supplied proof descriptions or local results are independently attested
No replacement of existing canonical context/implementation/review skill instruction bodies
decisions: A candidate-controlled review packet is a declared observation, never an independently authorized acceptance policy; gate/test changes always require out-of-band review.

obligations.description: Bind review packet to exact baseline/head/tree and tracked candidate diff; missing/undeclared changed paths and dirty inputs prevent review-ready.
Select independent predeclared scenarios including negative/fault/temporal where applicable; detect absent proof, post-hoc oracle changes and missing UI proof for visible changes.
Detect changes to tests, instructions, CI, gates or contract schemas and require separate baseline-controlled control-change assessment; candidate labels cannot self-waive.
Report material findings as blockers, distinguish unknown from success; no reviewer request required and readiness never implies accepted/CI verified.
Maintain Linux/Windows stdlib-only CLI and existing v1 commands without changing Actions workflows or protected repository settings.

structure: src/sf/assurance.py: strict review packet schema, read-only git identity/diff, source-bound case and findings gate
src/sf/cli.py: explicit sf review and sf readiness read-only entrypoints
tests/test_assurance.py: independent fixture repos, falsification and control-drift negative cases
docs/factory/SF11_ASSURANCE.md: contract, trust and proof boundaries
impact: Review requires declared cases and substantive observations, but never reviewer requests or review-score dependencies
Source/test/CI/policy modifications trigger explicit control-change findings
Adds no network or authority-bearing external effects; preserves other CLI operations

budget.network: No network for implementation or review; PR validation only on stable candidate.
budget.execution: Run focused local tests; one final native Linux/Windows PR validation, rerun only after real correction.

externalEffects: PR #20 stacked on PR #19; no merge until operator-authorized PR #22 boundary
No ruleset/Actions changes or other repository writes
No releases, deployment, reviewer requests or permission escalation
